title: [Transform] add support for unsigned_long data type

timeline.message:
add support for unsigned_long, which required a change in
writing out integer results properly, because coerce is not
supported for unsigned_long

fixes #63871
timeline.author: Hendrik Muhs

diff.patch:
@@ -316,7 +316,7 @@ private void putIndex(String indexName, String dateType, boolean isDataStream) t
                     .field("type", "keyword")
                     .endObject()
                     .startObject("metric")
-                    .field("type", "integer")
+                    .field("type", randomFrom("integer", "long", "unsigned_long"))
                     .endObject()
                     .startObject("location")
                     .field("type", "geo_point")

timeline.body:
add support for unsigned_long, which required a change in
writing out integer results properly, because coerce is not
supported for unsigned_long

fixes #63871

```suggestion
    public static Object convertToDiscreteNumeralTypeIfNeeded(String type, double value) {
```
Or some better name as this is is not an `integer` but instead some possibly large discrete numeral (big int or a long).

reply.body: its referring to the mathematical definition of integer, that's why integer _type_, not integer. I can try to find a better name, maybe `dropFloatingPointComponentIfNeeded`, but lets not over-complicate it, the doc string defines what it does.

timeline.body:
Its weird to me that there is not a blanket `map doc value -> indexable value` :(

This works in a pinch, I wonder if there is anyway to use `DocValueFormat.UNSIGNED_LONG_SHIFTED`.

But looking at it, there isn't a clean cut solution :/
